body:
@olance about your proposition yes it would work but it would be cool if we could find a simpler way to do it because it look like a lot of code for a simple `<label>`

I would want to be able as a user to say `{label: 'select smg' }` in the option of the sort by selector.

If anyone has an idea on how to do it without breaking things for people that would be cool

The original request from @Shipow makes sense as a user perspective:

> I think that adding a label should be allowed by the widget same way as refinementList allows header.
